description: graft a WBS-derived execution segment into the active plan tail while preserving plan lineage. The platform renumbers the grafted steps mechanically.
embedding_description: Graft execution steps into active plan. Splice WBS-derived execution steps after the current step. Deterministic tail replacement with automatic renumbering. Preserves plan lineage without full plan replacement.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: The active plan has been updated with the grafted execution steps
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: The execution segment has been grafted into the active plan. Continue executing the current step as shown in the updated ACTIVE_PLAN.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Grafting execution steps into the active plan. graft_work_breakdown_structure_segment accepts {wbs_id, anchor_step_number}. The platform reads the WBS and projects the next incomplete work item's steps automatically.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError: arguments do not conform to the schema. NotFoundError: no focused plan to graft into.
